requirements_summary:
- Workload: ticket deflection + agent assist (RAG)
- Index scale target: 30M-50M documents (text chunks), daily delta ~50k
- Query qps target: sustained 150-250 qps, spiky bursts to 400 qps
- Latency SLO (end-to-end): p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 600ms (embedding NN + cross-encoder rerank)
- Quality target: top-5 rerank MRR increase >= 18% vs current BM25 hybrid
- Cost sensitivity: target cost/query <$0.02 for standard deflection queries
- Model preferences: open/compressed reranker (cross-encoder) + dense embeddings; consider quantized weights for CPU fallback
- Routing/fallback: prefer dedicated for production; hosted tier acceptable for dev; automatic fallback to smaller reranker on overload
notes:
- Customer is a platform provider to enterprise contact centers; deflection is primary KPI.
- Quote from Head of Product: "If we can shave 200ms off p95 and keep top5 precision, we can justify replacing current vector stack."
- SE notes (Arjun): indexing pipeline must support incremental upserts, TTL for ephemeral KBs, shard strategy to keep local NN latency predictable.
- Security: must support VPC peering + KMS for keys, EU data residency for EU customers (primary blocker).
- PoC observations: embedding index (10M) p50 retrieval ~18ms, p95 ~70ms on dedicated instance; reranker cross-encoder on single A10x4 replicaset p95 ~320ms for batch of 5; combined end-to-end p95 currently ~520ms — close but spikes observed at 200+ concurrent queries.
- Cost note: estimated baseline per-query cost for current PoC (cloud-hosted dedicated GPU) ~$0.035 — customer target <$0.02, ask Optimize team for quantization + caching suggestions.
- Next demo: focused on batching + prefix caching to reduce p95, scheduled 2026-03-18 (hold until security review progress).
